title: KL-Regularized RLHF Policy Objective
seoDescription: Compute a sampled KL penalty and mean regularized policy objective from current, reference, and reward log probabilities.
description:
Compute the KL-penalized reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) objective trading off reward maximization against reference model drift.

**Mathematical Formulation:**

$$
J(\theta) = \mathbb{E}[R(x, y)] - \beta \, \mathbb{D}_{\text{KL}}(\pi_\theta(y \mid x) \parallel \pi_{\text{ref}}(y \mid x))
$$

**Step-by-Step Implementation:**
1. Compute token-level or sequence-level log-probability difference log(pi / ref).
2. Scale the KL divergence estimate by penalty coefficient beta.
3. Subtract penalty from scalar task reward.
4. Return regularized objective value.

**Returns:** Float representing KL-penalized objective.

### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Compute the KL-penalized reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) objective trading off reward maximization against reference model drift.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
def cs336_l15_kl_regularized_policy_objective(reward: float, policy_logprob: float, ref_logprob: float, beta: float = 0.05) -> float:
    return round(float(reward - beta * (policy_logprob - ref_logprob)), 6)
```
